title: Privilege or root change via chroot (c) — review required
description: The c call chroot changes privilege or filesystem root. Mistakes lock in excessive power or an escapable jail. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the drop order and confinement via chdir plus closed descriptors after chroot.
remediation: Confirm chdir plus closed descriptors after chroot.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any chroot call matches.
